brief.headline: KKR Agreed to Acquire Fund Administrator Gen II for $5.1 Billion from Hg and General Atlantic
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: KKR has agreed to acquire Gen II Fund Services, one of the largest independent administrators of private capital funds.

Private Credit: KKR's non-traded business development company KKR FS Income Trust Select has agreed to meet all investor withdrawal requests after quarterly repurchase demands narrowly exceeded its 5% redemption limit, according to a report any Bloomberg.
Hedge Funds: KKR FS Income Trust Select, the nontraded business development company known as K-FITS.

Investor Outlook: On Inside Blackstone, host Christine Anderson sits down with The RealReal CEO Rati Sahi Levesque on why most young shoppers now check the resale price before they buy anything new, how robots and AI authentication changed the economics of selling one-of-a-kind items.
AI & Technology: Bridgewater Associates has moved from publishing research on artificial intelligence to actively lobbying for policy on it.
brief.marketRead: The S&P 500 stands at 7,773.95 (up 0.7% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 15.5, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 5.28% (up 4 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.47 pts (positively sloped). Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits.
